Four buildings are located in a square orientation to each other. Fisch Stix Food Company is requesting a PtMP link between the buildings. On the building with the root bridge link, what type of antenna is the best choice?
A 100-degree sector antenna provides a defined directional coverage wedge suitable for a point-to-multipoint layout when the buildings are arranged around a common site.
What are some common problems with short (12 or fewer characters) ASCII passphrases in WPA/WPA2-Personal networks?
They are more susceptible to dictionary attacks than longer passphrases.
They lead to weak group keys in a BSS.
They only produce a 64-bit PMK instead of a 256-bit PMK.
Very few AP and client vendors support entry of an ASCII-based passphrase.
Short ASCII passphrases have a smaller search space and are more vulnerable to dictionary and brute-force attacks than longer, randomly generated passphrases.
What advantages are provided by per-user PSKs when compared with ESS-wide PSKs?(Choose all that apply.)
Per-user PSKs allow easier user-based access control with WPA/WPA2-Personal security.
Per-user PSKs are easier to manage if a PSK is compromised or an employee leaves a company.
Per-user PSKs are standardized and certified by the Wi-Fi Alliance.
Per-user PSKs are more secure than ESS-wide PSKs because they support mutual authentication.
Per-user PSKs limit the impact of a credential compromise. You can revoke or rotate one user's key when a user leaves without changing the shared key for every device on the ESS.
The process of incorporating a chipping code to build resilience
The process of encoding data symbols using a carrier frequency
The process of modifying a carrier signal to represent data
The process of representing data using RF coding
Modulation changes a carrier wave's properties to encode information. The receiver interprets those changes to recover the transmitted data.
Left to its simplest form, what method does a location algorithm use to determine location within a WLAN coverage area?
The simplest location approach estimates distance from received signal level using a path-loss model such as Free Space Path Loss. Accuracy is limited by real-world propagation variation.
Which of the following is not a business requirement?
The new network design must improve employee productivity.
The new network design must cut operating expenses.
The new network design must make employees happy to come to work.
The new network design must provide support for 802.11n.
A requirement for a particular IEEE technology is a technical solution constraint, not a business outcome. Business requirements describe what the organization needs to achieve.
The thermal noise is at −174 dBm/Hz. A spectrum analyzer has a resolution bandwidth of 1 kHz and a 5 dB noise figure. What is the level of the noise floor?
Thermal noise is −174 dBm/Hz. A 1 kHz resolution bandwidth adds 30 dB, and a 5 dB analyzer noise figure gives −139 dBm.
What operational plane would a WNMS primarily interact with?
A WLAN management system primarily interacts with the management plane, which is responsible for configuration, monitoring, and administration.
In the enterprise, when is WPA/WPA2-Personal generally a recommended solution?(Choose all that apply.)
When client devices do not support 802.1X/EAP
When mobile device applications require high-latency roaming times between APs
When client devices are provisioned in bulk and would otherwise share 802.1X credentials
When the network security policy demands that each user have unique access credentials

WPA/WPA2-Personal may be a practical compatibility choice when clients cannot perform 802.1X/EAP or when devices are provisioned in bulk and individual credentials are not feasible. It trades away per-user identity and accountability.
How are EAP messages transported over 802.11 wireless LANS?
EAP over LAN (EAPOL) transports 802.1X/EAP authentication messages between the wireless client and the authenticator.

NicoCo is building a new facility and would like to install a WLAN for primary connectivity of all clients. The requirements are dual-spectrum 802.11n supporting voice and location tracking. What type of pre-deployment survey should be performed?
Active, using a lowest common denominator client
A predictive survey models RF propagation from floor plans, materials, and AP characteristics before installation. It is appropriate for a new facility without an existing WLAN to measure.
What factors are key features when designing a guest network for a large enterprise?(Choose all that apply.)
Large enterprise guest WLANs should control bandwidth with rate limits and keep guest traffic isolated by tunneling or anchoring it to a designated security zone such as a DMZ.
In an RSN requiring low-latency reassociations and no fast secure roaming protocols, what security solutions are ideal for protecting VoWiFi communication?(Choose all that apply.)

WPA2-Personal and WPA2-Enterprise both use AES/CCMP link encryption. Enterprise mode adds per-user 802.1X/EAP authentication, while Personal mode uses a pre-shared key; the absence of fast-roaming protocols can still affect reassociation time.
For what types of systems should you request read-only access to in order to perform an analysis of the customers existing infrastructure?(Choose all that apply.)

Switches and routers contain the existing Layer 2 and Layer 3 configuration needed to understand VLANs, routing, uplinks, and network dependencies. Read-only access allows discovery without changing production settings.
What is the chip rate of 1 Mbps 802.11b?
The 1 Mbps 802.11b DSSS PHY uses an 11 Mchip/s chip rate. The chip rate is not the same as the user data rate.
What strategy can be used to ensure efficient cell overlap for VoIP site surveys?
Measure the percentage of cell overlap using the cell overlap feature in the site survey software.
Increase the output power of the radio in all APs.
Install higher gain antennas in the APs.
Ensure at least two APs can be seen with appropriate signal strengths from each location.
The survey tool's cell-overlap feature quantifies how much neighboring AP coverage overlaps, helping confirm the overlap needed for voice roaming.
During a post-validation assessment, you have configured a client for 802.1X/EAP but it is not passing authentication. Which areas should you check in the WLAN configuration?
Whether the RADIUS server is online and configured for the matching port on the APs and WLAN controllers
Whether the RADIUS shared secret is properly configured on the supplicant and authentication server
Whether the authenticator is configured to support the EAP type(s) your client is configured for
Whether the client has a fully valid certificate
RADIUS provides centralized AAA between the WLAN authenticator and the authentication service; it can validate users against a connected identity store such as LDAP.
A high power radio system transmits at 40,000 Watts. What is this power in dBm? Solve this without a calculator.
40,000 W is 46 dBW; adding 30 converts dBW to dBm, giving 76 dBm.

One of your warehouse customers called you reporting problems with their WLAN in some locations that you designed and installed over a year ago. What should be one of your first considerations for your line of questioning?
Warehouse inventory changes alter the composition and density of racks and stored goods. Metal, liquids, and changing stock can materially change RF propagation after deployment.
When designing for a PTP outdoor link, what important consideration should be made about local vegetation?(Choose all that apply.)
Vegetation can obstruct the RF path, and seasonal growth can intrude into the Fresnel zone over time; account for both current foliage and future growth.
